id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description: The specification used for retrieving ui metadata to be displayed by the component renderer

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

metadataToRender.description: Metadata for the component(s) to render dynamically.

useInitialMetadata.description:
Flag indicating for a component to use the initial metadata provided to it. This is useful for
dynamic components which obtain their metadata from another source (i.e. application state).

childIds.description: The metadata ids of children that are dynamically added through {@link #updateChildrenMetadataAction}.

children.description: The metadata ids of children that are dynamically added through {@link #updateChildrenMetadataAction}.

componentRefIds.description: The metadata ids of all componentRefs that are dynamically added through {@link #updateChildrenMetadataAction}.
